configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: Day to day: Clang, LLD and the LLVM tools, with the MSVC STL as the C++ library, for x86-64-v3 -- AVX2, the least this tree builds for. No developer prompt: Clang finds Visual Studio's STL and the Windows SDK by itself.

configurePresets.name: windows-avx512
configurePresets.description: The same build raised to x86-64-v4, with 512-bit vectors. Needs AVX-512 -- Intel's Xeons from Skylake-SP on, Ice Lake, Tiger Lake and Rocket Lake, AMD's Zen 4 on -- and stops at its first AVX-512 instruction on a processor without it, Alder Lake and Raptor Lake included.

configurePresets.name: windows-native
configurePresets.description: The same build for exactly the processor it is built on, with 512-bit vectors where it has AVX-512. For that machine alone: another may lack an instruction it uses, and stop there.

configurePresets.name: windows-core-only
configurePresets.description: What CI builds to keep the portable half portable, and to keep the engine free of the player. No platform head, no modules.

configurePresets.name: windows-measure
configurePresets.displayName: Windows, Release with the measuring apparatus kept
configurePresets.description: An optimised build that still has `compare` and `verify`, so the decode-quality check can run at Release speed rather than Debug speed.

configurePresets.name: windows-asan
configurePresets.description: The parsers under ASan and UBSan, without the Windows head. Clang has no vptr check for the MSVC ABI and no thread sanitizer for Windows.

configurePresets.name: windows-fuzz
configurePresets.description: libFuzzer over every parser that reads somebody else's file, with the static C runtime libFuzzer is built against.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: Clang, LLD and the LLVM tools, with the system's libstdc++ as the C++ library, for x86-64-v3 -- AVX2, the least this tree builds for. Everything but the Windows head and the Windows modules.

configurePresets.name: linux-avx512
configurePresets.description: The same build raised to x86-64-v4, with 512-bit vectors. Needs AVX-512 -- Intel's Xeons from Skylake-SP on, Ice Lake, Tiger Lake and Rocket Lake, AMD's Zen 4 on -- and stops at its first AVX-512 instruction on a processor without it, Alder Lake and Raptor Lake included.

configurePresets.name: linux-native
configurePresets.description: The same build for exactly the processor it is built on, with 512-bit vectors where it has AVX-512. For that machine alone: another may lack an instruction it uses, and stop there.

configurePresets.name: linux-asan
configurePresets.displayName: Linux, address, undefined and vptr sanitizers
configurePresets.description: Everything the linux preset builds, and its tests, under AddressSanitizer with LeakSanitizer, UBSan and the vptr check. RelWithDebInfo: a sanitizer is not for a link-time optimised build.

configurePresets.name: linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: Everything the linux preset builds, and its tests, under ThreadSanitizer and UBSan: races between the engine's threads and locks taken in orders that could stop them, which nothing else finds.

configurePresets.name: linux-fuzz
configurePresets.displayName: Linux, fuzzers under the address, undefined and vptr sanitizers
configurePresets.description: libFuzzer over every parser that reads somebody else's file, with LeakSanitizer, which Windows has none of.

configurePresets.name: linux-fuzz-tsan
configurePresets.displayName: Linux, fuzzers under the thread and undefined sanitizers
configurePresets.description: The same fuzzers under ThreadSanitizer, for the libraries that start threads of their own and the code that shares with them.

configurePresets.name: linux-fuzz-msan
configurePresets.displayName: Linux, fuzzers under the memory and undefined sanitizers
configurePresets.description: The same fuzzers under MemorySanitizer, against libc++ and a libFuzzer built with it: MEDIAPERCH_MSAN_LIBRARIES in the environment names their prefix, which ci/msan-libraries.sh writes.
